description: Read one order and its safe participant projection. The server derives the actor side from current order membership; if the actor has both memberships in the order, the CREATOR projection is used. Requires read scope. The Public API applies current tenant, role, account-access, and object permissions. Pass only IDs returned to this API key; the server derives the acting user and account. Brand-facing DTOs include only the brand’s own B/Fb/T and own outcome amounts; creator fees, net income, and combined fees stay hidden. Creator-facing DTOs include only the creator’s own B/Fc/N and own outcome amounts. Every creator offer carries: “Сумма заказа заморожена на платформе до приёмки работы рекламодателем”.

title: Get my placement order
